# 3D Fractal Multiverse PWA — Steven Kleynenberg

> Canonical Dossier: https://steven.kleynenberg.com/pp/fract/
> Live Cloud App: https://fract.kleynenberg.com/
> Featured Node 10 Deeplink: https://fract.kleynenberg.com/#uni=10&ft=10&seed=452839&x=0&y=0&z=0.49977559077972916&cs=0.2878
> Static PWA Mirror: https://steven.kleynenberg.com/pp/fract/pwa/
> Author: Steven Kleynenberg (Delft, The Netherlands) — steven@kleynenberg.com

## Overview
Monolithic WebGL 2.0 and WebAudio fractal exploration Progressive Web Application featuring 13 Peitgen/Mandelbrot/Julia archetypes, arbitrary-precision perturbation theory via Decimal.js, 3D barrier warp transitions, multi-user Python aiohttp WebSocket telemetry (`fractal_server.py`), video demonstrations, and an accompanying IEEEtran manuscript (`fractal.tex` / `fractal.pdf`).
